title: Frontend targets a different backend port
explanation: The ShopSphere client uses port 9090, while the Spring Boot server is configured for port 8080.
risk: The browser requests the API at a port where this backend is not configured to listen.
recommendedFix: Use the backend's configured port or provide a single configurable API base URL.

title: Products endpoint is not implemented
explanation: The ShopSphere frontend requests /api/products, but the backend controller source only defines the /api/auth route.
risk: The product request cannot be served by the current backend, leaving the demo catalog empty.
recommendedFix: Implement the endpoint if product data is in scope, or remove the unsupported request from the demo UI.

title: MySQL datasource has no JDBC driver dependency
explanation: The backend configures a MySQL datasource and includes Spring Data JPA, but the Maven dependencies do not declare a MySQL JDBC driver.

evidence.detail: Dependencies include spring-boot-starter-data-jpa but no MySQL connector.

risk: The configured datasource cannot be initialized with the declared runtime dependencies.
recommendedFix: For this database-free demo, remove the unused datasource/JPA settings; otherwise declare and configure the intended driver.

title: Verbose DEBUG logging is configured
explanation: Root and Spring Web log levels are set to DEBUG. The inspected source does not show request-body or authorization-header logging.
risk: Debug-level framework logs can be unnecessarily verbose outside local development.
recommendedFix: Use INFO or WARN for normal operation and enable DEBUG only when troubleshooting.

title: ShopSphere frontend is missing its Vite entry file
explanation: The frontend package defines a Vite build script, but there is no index.html at the Vite project root.

evidence.detail: The project root contains package.json and src/, but no index.html.

risk: The ShopSphere frontend production build fails before transforming application modules.
recommendedFix: Add the Vite HTML entry with a root element and a module script for /src/main.jsx.
